metadata.question: Was the surface color of Lake Ijssel near Kornwerderzand visibly greener than near Afsluitdijk on July 8, 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Area: Lake Ijssel (IJsselmeer) near Kornwerderzand vs Afsluitdijk – coordinates already obtained (approx points on shoreline). Collection: Sentinel-2 (10 m color, 4-band 10 m) – gives true-color green info. Date: 2023-07-08 (single-day imagery). 2. Masking: Need to mask clouds but NOT water – we are interested in the water surface. Because the question asks about “surface color… greener” we must keep water pixels, and clouds must be masked to see the surface. Sentinel-2 Scene Classification Layer (SCL) will mask clouds. 3. Metric: Use green reflectance band (B3, 560 nm) as proxy for “greener” appearance (plus an NDVI-style check to be sure we aren’t seeing vegetation). Compute the mean of Band 3 (green) for two small 600 m buffer polygons around the two sites; then compare: if Kornwerderzand mean_green > Afsluitdijk mean_green → A (Yes); else → B. 4. Data quality checks: - If no image for 2023-07-08 ±1 day, try ±5 days; if still 0, output C1. - After masking clouds, if either polygon has 0 pixels left, output C2. - If resulting mean is None/NaN, output C3. Geo extracted: Kornwerderzand 52.8502, 5.3352 Afsluitdijk 52.9331, 5.4020 ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') korn = ee.Geometry.Point([5.3352, 52.8502]).buffer(300) afsl = ee.Geometry.Point([5.4020, 52.9331]).buffer(300) d1 = '2023-07-08' col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(d1, ee.Date(d1).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(korn) .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('SCL').eq(6)))) # keep clear water only if col.size().getInfo() == 0: # widen by 4 days each side col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate('2023-07-03', '2023-07-13') .filterBounds(korn) .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('SCL').eq(6)))) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No images found.") print("C1") import sys; sys.exit() img = col.first() for label, geom in (('Kornwerderzand', korn), ('Afsluitdijk', afsl)): cnt = img.select('B3').reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=geom, scale=10, maxPixels=1e9).get('B3').getInfo() if cnt is None or cnt == 0: print("No valid pixels after masking.") print("C2") import sys; sys.exit() meanG = img.select('B3').reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=10, maxPixels=1e9).get('B3').getInfo() if meanG is None: print("Calculation failed.") print("C3") import sys; sys.exit() print(f"{label} green B3: {meanG/1e4:.3f} pixels: {int(cnt)}") if label == 'Kornwerderzand': gK = meanG else: gA = meanG print("A" if gK > gA else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

korn = ee.Geometry.Point([5.3352, 52.8502]).buffer(300)
afsl = ee.Geometry.Point([5.4020, 52.9331]).buffer(300)

d1 = '2023-07-08'
col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
         .filterDate(d1, ee.Date(d1).advance(1, 'day'))
         .filterBounds(korn)
         .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('SCL').eq(6))))  # keep clear water only

if col.size().getInfo() == 0:  # widen by 4 days each side
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
             .filterDate('2023-07-03', '2023-07-13')
             .filterBounds(korn)
             .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('SCL').eq(6))))
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print("No images found.")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        import sys; sys.exit()

img = col.first()

for label, geom in (('Kornwerderzand', korn), ('Afsluitdijk', afsl)):
    cnt = img.select('B3').reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                                        geometry=geom, scale=10, maxPixels=1e9).get('B3').getInfo()
    if cnt is None or cnt == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after masking.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
        import sys; sys.exit()
    meanG = img.select('B3').reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                                          geometry=geom, scale=10, maxPixels=1e9).get('B3').getInfo()
    if meanG is None:
        print("Calculation failed.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        import sys; sys.exit()
    print(f"{label} green B3: {meanG/1e4:.3f}  pixels: {int(cnt)}")
    if label == 'Kornwerderzand': gK = meanG
    else: gA = meanG

print("<answer>A</answer>" if gK > gA else "<answer>B</answer>")
